ocl.definition: existingStore:Store = Store.allInstance()->any(s | s.Id = id), storeExisted:Boolean = if existingStore.oclIsUndefined() then false else true endif
ocl.postcondition: if storeExisted then result = false else let newStore:Store in newStore.oclIsNew() and Store.allInstance()->includes(newStore) and newStore.Id = id and newStore.Name = name and newStore.Address = address and newStore.IsOpened = isopened and result = true endif
